changes.title: Swoop trails
items: Party witches leave bright rainbow glow trails as they swoop up over the treetops and back down, like fireworks over the canopy

changes.title: Broom kinds
items: Fourteen new brooms to pick in the creator: a missile, a curled tip, handlebars, a hobby horse, a jet bike, an oar, a mop, a pitchfork, a canoe, a ladder, a speeder bike, a bicycle, a quad drone and a gyrocopter, each in your own two colours, with flames, spinning wheels, rotors and propellers, and drips

changes.title: Longer cloak scarf
items: Much longer cloaks and scarves in the creator: a cloak can stream far out behind you in flight and trail along the ground when you stand, and a scarf can fly out behind you, both rippling as you go
